Check the installed files of a model

Source: R/cache.R
model_status.Rd

model_status() checks the installed files of a pinned model: for each file the model needs, it reports where the file is expected in the cache, whether it exists, and whether its size and SHA-256 hash match the pinned values. A pinned model is usable only when each of its files is present and identical to the file the package was pinned to; size and hash establish that identity, so a truncated download or a modified file is detected before it can produce wrong embeddings.

It reads the cache only; nothing is downloaded or repaired. The result is a data frame with one row per required file.

To install missing or invalid files, use model_download(); to delete a model, model_remove().

Usage

model_status(cache_dir = default_cache_dir(), model = "all-MiniLM-L6-v2")

Arguments

cache_dir

Cache root (default cache_dir()).

model

Name of a pinned model, as listed by models() (default "all-MiniLM-L6-v2").

Value

A base data frame with one row per required file and columns file, path (its expected location), exists, valid (size and hash both match), expected_bytes, and actual_bytes (NA when the file is missing).

Conditions

sbert_unknown_model when model names no pinned model.

See also

model_download() to install; model_remove() to delete; cache_size() for disk use; load_model(), which runs the same check.

Examples

# An empty cache: every file is missing.
model_status(tempdir())
#>             file
#> 1     model.onnx
#> 2 tokenizer.json
#>                                                                                       path
#> 1     /tmp/RtmpjrAgkS/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41/model.onnx
#> 2 /tmp/RtmpjrAgkS/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41/tokenizer.json
#>   exists valid expected_bytes actual_bytes
#> 1  FALSE FALSE       90405214           NA
#> 2  FALSE FALSE         466247           NA
model_status(tempdir(), model = "potion-base-8M")
#>                file
#> 1 model.safetensors
#> 2    tokenizer.json
#> 3       config.json
#>                                                                                        path
#> 1 /tmp/RtmpjrAgkS/potion-base-8M/bf8b056651a2c21b8d2565580b8569da283cab23/model.safetensors
#> 2    /tmp/RtmpjrAgkS/potion-base-8M/bf8b056651a2c21b8d2565580b8569da283cab23/tokenizer.json
#> 3       /tmp/RtmpjrAgkS/potion-base-8M/bf8b056651a2c21b8d2565580b8569da283cab23/config.json
#>   exists valid expected_bytes actual_bytes
#> 1  FALSE FALSE       30236760           NA
#> 2  FALSE FALSE         683666           NA
#> 3  FALSE FALSE            202           NA
